**CodexLB-up 1.27.0 is the stable release.** It includes the changes from all four 1.26.0 prereleases and updates the Python, Docker, and Helm installation commands. [Changes since 1.25.0](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/compare/v1.25.0...v1.27.0)

## Conversation recovery and streaming

- When Codex reconnects and sends the full history plus a new turn, the proxy verifies the original input and the entire output of the last completed response. It matches tool results to calls by type and `call_id`, including results returned in reverse order. If the history matches and can be replayed on the new WebSocket, the proxy forwards it without inserting the old `previous_response_id`. [PR #5](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/pull/5)
- A client that sends only new messages needs a valid parent response or its full history to recover. File references remain bound to the account that owns them. To diagnose a WebSocket closure with code `1011`, check the underlying transport read error. [WebSocket burst handling](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/commit/5d98cf60) · [OpenAI WebSocket guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/websocket-mode)
- When the upstream SSE read times out, the proxy propagates the error and closes the stream. It sends heartbeats only while a read is pending. [SSE fix](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/commit/fc10f4d5)

## Models, usage, and pricing

- The proxy checks each account's model catalog for Ultrafast access. For GPT-6.2 Astra, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-6.1 Sol, it calculates cost using the request date, input, cached input, output, context length, and the service tier the provider reports when available. [Ultrafast accounting](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/commit/2525877d) · [OpenAI pricing](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing)
- Total tokens equal input plus output. When usage data is incomplete, the dashboard marks the known lower bound with `≥`. Plan names, including Business Premium, follow Codex account data. The dashboard uses the reported balance for purchased credits and labels subscription estimates separately. [Token accounting and plan names](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/releases/tag/v1.26.0-beta.2) · [Dashboard changes](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/pull/4)

## Installation and compatibility

The release page's `uvx` command installs this exact version. The package guide and the examples for upgrading from upstream beta.9 now pin the Python package, Docker image, and Helm chart to 1.27.0. The Alembic migrations are identical to those in 1.25.0 and 1.26.0-beta.4. [Installation and upgrade guide](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/blob/v1.27.0/docs/distribution.md)

The upstream review compares conversation recovery and account selection in OmniRoute and Frozen811. Its index lists all 147 open pull requests and 128 open issues in Soju06/codex-lb as of November 24, 2026. [Download the upstream review](https://github.com/Lok3rn3t/codexLB-up/releases/download/v1.27.0/codexlb-up-1.27.0-upstream-review.en.md)
